'''Maggis''' was a teacher in the days before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was a professor of navigation and sublight technology at the [[Celestial School of Spaceflight Engineering]] on [[Argus]]. When the Empire was established he became an Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]] and took a position as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] and guardian advisor at the [[Imperial Naval Academy (Coruscant)|Imperial Naval Academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He soon found out that he didn't like being an Imperial officer and decided to help [[Trever Flume]] escape when he was trying to rescue [[Lune Oddo Divinian]]. After rescuing Lune, who was aided by [[Ferus Olin]] in his escape, Trever took him down to the [[Orange District]] in [[Thugger's Alley]] and [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] directed him to another [[Erased]] safe house to help him become one of the Erased and disappear off Imperial radars.<ref name="LOTJATE" />
